generators.name: interface ESM-2 mutation
generators.description: Propose amino-acid substitutions within the active interface region using ESM-2 masked sampling while non-interface positions remain fixed.

generators.name: interface MPNN mutation
generators.description: Propose structure-conditioned mutations on interface residues using ProteinMPNN against the on-target PDB template.

evidence.quote: Optimize an existing binder interface for high target binding and low off-target binding.

constraints.name: target interface ipTM
constraints.description: Require high predicted interface confidence for binder-on-target complex.

constraints.name: Boltz2 binding strength
constraints.description: Score on-target binding affinity and complex confidence with Boltz-2.

constraints.name: AF3 off-target ipTM specificity
constraints.description: Prefer high on-target ipTM margin over best off-target ipTM in batched AF3 folding.

evidence.quote: Sai fusion target: dual target + off-target structure scoring every step.

constraints.name: interface contact loss
constraints.description: Maintain AF2 binder interface contacts against the on-target template PDB.

optimizers.name: region-local MCMC refinement
optimizers.description: Optimize one interface patch per pass with masked proposals and dual target/off-target structure scoring.

model_dependencies.name: AlphaFold3
model_dependencies.purpose: On-target ipTM and off-target specificity margin scoring

model_dependencies.name: AlphaFold2 binder
model_dependencies.purpose: Interface contact loss on target PDB template

steps.operation: Select active interface patch for this region pass
ESM-2 or MPNN masked mutation within active interface
Score target ipTM, Boltz binding, AF3 specificity margin, and interface contacts
MCMC accept/reject on weighted constraint scores

assumptions: 65-aa miniprotein binder seed substitutes a published PD-L1 antagonist helix bundle.
On-target template PDB 4ZQK (PD-L1) and off-target PDB 4RWS (CXCR4) proxy cross-reactivity.
AF3 off-target ipTM specificity uses proto_language DNA-operator batch folding on the binder chain.
Interface IMGT-like patches are approximate 0-based half-open indices on the binder sequence.
Smoke tier uses ESM-2 on interface patch 1 only; full tier uses MPNN across two interface passes.
unknowns: proto_language af3-offtarget-iptm-specificity is protein-DNA; true protein-protein dual AF3 margin may need a future constraint.
Experimental binding affinity and cellular specificity are not modeled.
MPNN structure conditioning uses on-target PDB only; off-target structure is scored via AF3 specificity config.
